name: extract_artifact
description: Extract all or caller-selected regular files (including Node.js SEA scripts and assets) exposed by a supported active archive reader. Optionally select exact inventory occurrence_ids and an absent absolute output_root on the REA host; otherwise use a fresh temporary directory. The result records selected IDs and the actual output location; successful files persist after the call. Nested archive files are copied as files; inspect and extract them separately to unpack their contents. DMG extraction is unavailable; use a caller-managed read-only mount on macOS. Rejects traversal and symlink escapes, never overwrites, and verifies cleanup. Inventory integrity checks still cover the full input: mismatches fail by default; record-and-continue keeps extracted contradictions explicitly untrusted.
